name: EagleGaze
summary: Check and calibrate the local EagleGaze eye-tracking prototype by voice.
description: Controls the EagleGaze Mac app over a loopback-only bridge. Raw ARKit transforms and gaze coordinates are not returned to VoiceOS.

tools.name: get_gaze_status
tools.title: Gaze status
tools.description: Check the local EagleGaze phone connection, Mac companion, and calibration state. Use when the user asks whether eye tracking is installed, connected, calibrated, ready, or currently evaluating. If the Mac companion is unavailable, return the first-run install card.

tools.name: start_gaze_calibration
tools.title: Start gaze calibration
tools.description: Start EagleGaze's full-screen nine-point calibration on this Mac. Use when the user asks to calibrate, recalibrate, or set up eye tracking.

children.text: EagleGaze will show nine targets across the main display. Keep the iPhone and your seating position still.

tools.name: reset_gaze_calibration
tools.title: Reset gaze calibration
tools.description: Clear EagleGaze's current calibration and return it to setup. Use only when the user explicitly asks to reset or clear eye-tracking calibration.

children.text: The current in-memory calibration will be cleared. You can immediately run calibration again.
